svg.title: Minu — HTML fragments, not a framework
svg.desc: Minu fetches server-rendered HTML and puts it where it belongs: zero runtime dependencies, 4.1 KB gzipped, MIT licensed.
svg.text: MIT · ZERO RUNTIME DEPS · 4.1 KB GZIP
Fetch server-rendered HTML and put it where it belongs.
Forms, polling, out-of-band swaps, and SSE.
No SPA, no router, no build step.
0 runtime deps · 4.1 KB gzip · 31 tests · MIT licensed
